title: Memory
description: A single unit of persistent knowledge stored by an AI agent.

type.description: Classifies the memory for scoring and retrieval tuning.

scope.description: Determines storage location and query visibility.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary. Indexed for full-text search.

content.description: Full structured knowledge body, typically Markdown.

topic_key.description: Stable dot-delimited key for deterministic upserts.

project.description: Normalised project slug. Empty for global/org memories.

session_id.description: UUIDv7 of the agent session that created this memory.

created_by.description: Identifier of the agent or actor (e.g. 'claude-code').

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent revision.

importance.description: Importance score. Higher = surfaced more aggressively.

confidence.description: Confidence that this memory is correct and current.

access_count.description: Number of times this memory has been retrieved.

last_accessed.description: Timestamp of most recent retrieval. Absent if never accessed.

superseded_by.description: ID of the newer memory that replaces this one.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Present only for archived memories.

files.description: Source file paths related to this memory.

applies_to.description: Patterns for rule matching. Only meaningful when type=rule.

severity.description: Enforcement level. Only meaningful when type=rule.
